tools.name: get_plug_record
tools.description: Returns the publication's plug record (contract 1.4.0 and later): W-3 plug dates on the Railroad Commission of Texas Full Wellbore file, counted by the calendar year the operator reported and by district, as published. Without a district it returns the statewide count for each year and each district
